reviewed_by: Codex iPhone assistant and Voice layout review
reason: The installed iPhone app exposed a cramped Nebula assistant header and a Voice orb that rose over the safe-area header when long project work and an error were visible. The selected component files cover assistant entry and Voice lifecycle. Two exact browser journeys now assert a full-width 48 px Voice action, a stable mobile panel, and an orb below the exit header during normal and failed connections. The matrix covers desktop Chromium 1440/1024, mobile Chromium and WebKit at 320/390/430, and both mobile engines in landscape. The shared impact catalog now maps assistant panel edits to the iPhone shell and Voice to landscape, preventing this omission in later changes. Production LAN Core and the installed physical iPhone are separate dogfood gates.
exclusions: No Python, Rust, or native iOS source changed; those test layers are not relevant. Server work, provider persistence, settings mutation, mission and browser journeys, and full suites are excluded. Browser tests use deterministic mocked Core and WebRTC for exact layout assertions; the live credential and actual microphone/speaker path require separate production Core and physical iPhone checks.
